Commentary.Commentary: Hope you enjoyed our coverage of this 2-match Test series. It was certainly an interesting contest and we enjoyed every bit of it. We hope you join us for upcoming matches as there's a lot of cricketing action coming our way. Till then, stay safe, be good and take care! Cheers!

So that's it from us! New Zealand were favourites to clinch this series and they've lived up to those expectations. This will give them a huge confidence boost as they have two big series coming up, they tour South Africa and then India. Zimbabwe, on the other hand, still have a lot to work on in the Test format but have plenty of positives to take from here. They can build on this and with more exposure, can only get better.

New Zealand skipper and Man Of The Match, KANE WILLIAMSON says it was a great effort from his boys and it was a great effort from his bowlers for taking 20 wickets on such a wicket. Wants to congratulate Zimbabwe for the fight they put up and how difficult they made it for his team. Adds it's tough but it's important to add balance even though it's unfortunate that some guys missed out. Clarifies that he's not interested in personal records and just wants to do what's best for the team, that if some record comes up in the process then it's good but he just works hard for the team. Further adds that there are players like Ross Taylor who are instrumental when you need the runs and need to take the game away from the opposition. Ends saying that he has loved coming to Zimbabwe and especially the hospitality shown to them by the Zimbabwean people.

Zimbabwe skipper, GRAEME CREMER says they definitely improved and his side showed a lot of fight, but is disappointed that they fell short. Also says that his guys fought it out really hard and it was a great effort. Further says that his side tried his best and wants to congratulate New Zealand for picking up 20 wickets. Wants to congratulate the opposition and thank them for coming to Zimbabwe and playing against them as they need the cricketing action and the exposure to get better. Ends saying that they next play Sri Lanka at home in October and are looking forward to putting up a good performance against them.

Man Of The Series, NEIL WAGNER says thank you and that he didn't expect something like this. Also says that this is for the guys and that Ish Sodhi and everybody bowled really well. Credits fielders like Tom Latham and Henry Nicholls for their catching. Adds that he just wanted to get the job done for his side and is glad to do so. Further adds that he's had a really good time and that's what matters. (On their series against South Africa) States that he and his team will try to do their best against them and give it their all.
KANE WILLIAMSON has been awarded the Man Of The Match award.

Earlier in the match, Kane Williamson, Ross Taylor, and Tom Latham set up a century for the visiting side to go past a good total of 500 plus in the 1st innings. And then a good fifty by Williamson and Taylor helped them put a target of 387 for the hosts. They have won this match with the biggest margin ever in Tests in terms of runs. The series is in their kitty and overall they will be happy with their efforts. They bowled well, batted exceptionally and took the series home. Stay tuned for the presentation.

The Zimbabwe batsmen put up a good fight but were undone by decisions which can be deemed questionable. Most important one of them was of Craig Ervine, their most in-form batsman in this match. Wickets tumbled quite quickly admittedly, but the home side will rue some which went against them. Had they not gone the other way, we could have witnessed a whole different scenario altogether. They battled it out magnificently well in the first innings, exceeding expectations and were doing quite well in this one as well. They showed the character needed and can keep their heads held high.

That is a comprehensive win for New Zealand as they took 5 wickets in this session to wrap up the series 2-0! What a bowling effort from the Black Caps to bundle out the hosts on 132. Credit goes to Martin Guptill and Ish Sodhi as they both took 3 wickets each to make Zimbabwe go weak in their knees after their pacers set up the tone for them.

OUT! AND THAT DOES IT... NEW ZEALAND HAVE DONE IT! The celebrations start and the Kiwis are hugging it out. Smiles go all around as the Zimbabwean heads fall down. Sodhi tosses this up around off, gives it quite a lot of air and it's a googly, Chinouya plants his foot forward and looks to defend. The ball kind of stops on him and pops up off his bat, straight into the hands of Kane Williamson at short cover. He pouches it with ease and brings an end to the home side's innings. NEW ZEALAND WIN THE MATCH BY 254 RUNS AND TAKE THE SERIES 2-0!
Full on off, blocked off the front foot.
MICHAEL CHINOUYA is the last man in.

OUT! PRINCE DEPARTS! Is this another wrong decision by the umpire? Absolute mayhem out there in the middle. We don't even have time to breathe! It's nicely flighted on middle, Masvaure presses forward in an attempt to defend. The ball goes off his pads and into the hands of Ross Taylor at first slip. A huge appeal goes up and the umpire raises his finger. But wait, there's some confusion. As Prince Masvaure is walking back to the pavilion, the on air commentators say that the southpaw has been given out for being caught at first slip. Very strange... replays show there was no bat involved whatsoever. He still has to walk back and that's another wicket down for Zimbabwe. New Zealand can smell victory here, you just know it.
Tossed up ball on off, pushed to covers.
Floated on off, blocked off the front foot and buried into the ground.
JOHN NYUMBU is the next man in to bat.

OUT! ANOTHER DICEY DECISION! Well, Graeme Cremer will be livid on that occasion, and the look on his face shows that. Tossed up just around off, from around the wicket, it's turning in heavily as it goes off the deck. Cremer presses forward and looks to defend it. It raps his pads and there's a huge appeal for a leg before. The umpire signals it as out but Cremer is completely unhappy with that. Replays show why. There was a big inside edge before the ball hit the pads. The Rhodesian skipper is so unfortunate, has to make the long walk back.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Tossed up on the stumps, it's driven down to mid on for nothing.
Shorter outside off, rips off the deck after pitching, Cremer is ready for it and plays it to point.
Going down leg, left alone by the batsman.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
That was cool. Tossed up outside off, googly which completely deceives the southpaw, he looks to play at it but the ball goes sharply away from him. Lovely stuff.
Googly on middle, some nice bounce there too, does well to defend it off the front foot.
Darts in a yorker on middle and off, Prince does well to dig this one out.
Bowls it on the stumps and gives it plenty of air, Masvaure stays steady and does well to block it out.
Looped up around off from around the wicket, Masvaure presses forward and jams it right beside his feet.
Nicely flighted on off stump, jammed back down the track to end the over.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Loopy and full on middle and off, buried into the track comfortably.
Quicker one pushed through on the stumps, GC hangs back and blocks it out with a straight bat.
Martin pitches this on a length, it turns back in to the batsman, it's turned in front of forward short leg.
Flights it up on leg, Cremer plants his front foot forward and pads it away. It goes off it and to leg slip.
A leg-spinner spinning back in to the left-hander, keeps low as well, Masvaure gets back and punches it out to extra cover.
Tossed up well around off, so teasing that, inviting Prince forward and he does that. In fact, does quite well to come forward and defend.
Darted on off, full in length, it's kept out bravely off the front foot.
Sodhi drags the length back on this, it's a leg-spinner too, Graeme Cremer gets back and nudges it square on the leg side for a single.
Nicely looped up from Sodhi, pitches it perfectly right around off, Graeme with a solid front foot defense.
Quicker one from Sodhi, Cremer doesn't pick this up. Tries to play at it but ends up inside edging in onto his pads.
Nice off-breaker around off, Prince Masvaure stays back and taps it gently to the off side. End of the over.
On off, slightly fuller in length, still some nice air on it, blocked out from deep within the crease.
Slightly shorter in length and around off, slight turn on it, not played at by the batsman.
Guptill floats it up well outside the off stump, it's left alone by the batsman.
Full and looped up well on middle and off, Prince gets forward and blocks it out with a nice straight bat.
Pushed quicker through the air but it's wide outside off, Masvaure still goes after it. Misses and it's into Watling's gloves.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Graeme has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Loopy ball around off, Cremer strides forward and defends it gently.
GRAEME CREMER is the new man in!

OUT! That was dead plumb! Zimbabwe slipping further now! Sodhi bowls a loopy delviery around middle, goes straight after pitching. Moor lunges forward to defend but misses and goes onto hit him on the pads right in front of the stumps. An appeal is made and the umpire raises his finger. Sodhi picks up his first wicket in this innings.
Loopy ball around off, pushed towards point.
Loopy ball around off, driven towards short covers.
Outside off, tapped away for nothing to end the over.
Floated up around off, a front foot block.
Drags the length back on this Martin, and it's pitched outside off, Moor stays back and cuts it square on the off side for a single.
Loopy and full outside off, it's driven to covers for no run.
Flighted nicely around off, Moor drives it to short cover. The fielder there dives to this left and saves runs for his side.
PETER MOOR is next in.

OUT! KANE WILLIAMSON, YOU BEAUTY! What a catch! Absolute blinder there from the Kiwi skipper. Guptill tosses this one outside off, gives it a lot of air as well, Williams leans into the shot and drives this really hard. Any other day the ball would have raced away to the boundary but not today. Kane Williamson at short cover, with cat-like reflexes, somehow holds on to the ball as it's hit like a bullet straight to him. Brilliant! Gets his side one step closer to victory. Top stuff.
Full on off, defended off the front foot.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Drags the length back to this, pitched outside off, Prince hangs back deep in his crease and keeps it out.
Darted at the base of off stump, kept out well by Prince.
Looped up around off, blocked off the front foot.

HUGE LBW APPEAL! Sternly turned down by the umpire. Tossed up nicely around off, it spins in sharply and Masvaure is stuck here. He is rapped on the pads and there's a huge appeal for a leg before. The umpire shakes his head and the replays show why, the ball would have gone on to miss leg stump.
Loopy and full on off, a front foot defense to end the over.
Martin gives it some nice flight and pitches it on middle and off, Sean gets behind the line and defends it into the track.
Much straighter from Guptill here, it's on middle and leg, blocked out with a straight bat.
FOUR! THAT'S CRUNCHED! Loopy and slightly shorter in length outside off, Williams goes back and cuts it through point for a boundary.
Full and way outside off, Williams leaves it alone.
Floated on middle and off, Williams kneels down and sweeps it fine down the leg side for a couple of runs.
Loopy ball on middle and leg, tucked to mid-wicket.
Leg-spinning ball form wide outside off, it is played well by the batsman.
Short ball outside off, cut to point for a single.
Serves it quick on off, blocked neatly.
FOUR! Loopy ball on middle and leg, it is lofted over mid-wicket for a boundary.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
FOUR! Edged and runs! Short and wide outside off, Prince goes behind and cuts it over the slip cordon, though it goes off the outer half of the bat.
Serves it outside off, left alone.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
off-spinning ball on off, it goes off the outside edge which falls just short of 2nd slip.
Loopy ball on off, Prince blocks it neatly.
Serves it quicker on off, Prine strides forward and defends it to covers.
Loopy ball on off, defended watchfully.
Loopy ball on off, defended watchfully but it goes off the inside edge on to the pads.
he batsman has pushed it to the cover region.
Short ball outside off, cut to backward point for three runs.
Serves it quicker on the stumps. Prince blocks it.
Tossed up ball outside off, Prince pushes it to covers with soft hands.
Ish Sodhi will continue to bowl form other end.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Tad short and wide outside off, Williams punches it to covers.
Tossed up ball on off, Sean strides forward and blocks it to the off side.
Sean Williams is the new man alongside Prince Masvaure. The former will take the strike and Martin Guptill will finish his pending over. Let's play!
... Day 5, Session 2 ...

Zimbabwe will not like the session after fighting hard both the batsmen were given out in an unfortunate way which has now put them on a back foot. Hereon, they will look to play their hearts out and try to draw this match. Do join us in a bit and we shall find out what happens.

That will be a good lunch for New Zealand as they have managed to pick up 2 wickets. The hosts were playing well and frustrated the Kiwi bowlers to an extent in the first hour of play. It took Santner to provide the first breakthrough in this session and then towards the end, Guptill removed Ervine to add more insult to their wounds.

OUT! Guptill has taken the wicket and Ervine departs! Tossed up ball outside off, Ervine strides forward and looks to push at it. The ball beats his defense and goes into the gloves of the keeper. They appeal for a caught behind and oh dear, it is given out. There was no connection with the bat but the umpire feels there was. Unlucky for Ervine but the Black Caps will take that. THAT IS LUNCH ON DAY 5!
Off-spinning ball on off, it spins away after pitching. It misses the outside edge by an inch.
Tossed up ball on off, worked to the off side.
Martin Guptill to bowl next.
On middle and leg, defended watchfully.
The batsman has driven it through mid off. One run added to the total.
On the pads, worked to the leg side.
FOUR! Cut away! Short and wide outside off, Ervine off his back foot crunches it through point for a boundary.
Loopy ball outside off, punched through covers for a single.
Leg-spinning ball from outside off, Prince blocks it.
On outside off, pushed to covers.
Tossed up ball on off, Prince looks to cut but it goes off the outside edge through slips for a single.
Loopy ball on off, pushed back to the bowler.
Serves it on off, played to the off side.
Full ball on off, pushed to the leg side.
Serves it on off, defended off his front foot in to the ground.
Serves it on off, defended off his front foot.
On the pads, worked to the leg side for a single.
Leg-spinning ball on off, it spins in. Prince blocks it.
Loopy ball on off, driven to covers.
Full toss on middle and off, pushed to mid on for a run.
Serves it on the pads, Ervine flicks it to square leg for a single.
Flatter delivery around off, Masvaure stays back and looks to play at this. Is lucky to get an inside edge which thuds onto his pads. That could have easily gone on to hit the off pole.
Mitchell nicely tosses this up around off, Prince prods forward, leans across and does well to block it out.
On middle and leg, Craig picks this off his pads and clips it down to fine leg for one run.

CHANCE OF A RUN OUT! But it goes begging. A decent throw and Prince Masvaure would have been gone. Ervine goes back this flighted delivery and tucks it to square leg. Guptill there collects the ball and fires in a wayward throw at Santner's end as Prince had set off for the single. It's too far away for him to collect so the Rhodesian batsman survives.
Loopy and full on the stumps, buried into the track on the on side.

DROPPED! That should have been taken, really. Santner nicely tosses this up on middle and off, turning in nicely, Masvaure prods forward to defend but gets an inside edge on this. It goes to Latham at forward short leg who gets low to take it. Gets his hands to it but is unable to keep a hold of it. To make things worse, he throws the ball to Santner who isn't paying attention. It goes past him as the batsmen take a single.
Short and wide outside off, Ervine stays back and cuts it through point for a brace.
on the pads, tucked to the leg side.
Full length ball on off, negotiated into the ground.
On the pads, worked to the leg side.
Loopy ball on off, Ervine blocks it with a good solid defence.
Tossed up ball on outside off, Ervine strides forward and blocks it.
Serves it full on off, defended watchfully.
Short outside off, flicked to mid-wicket.
Tossed up on off, pushed to mid off.

Tough chance! Serves it full outside off, it spins in. Masauvre off his back foot tries to play at it and then leave it. In the process, he nicks it but the appeal is turned down as the umpire feels it was a good leave without any connection.
Loopy ball on middle and leg, swept to fine leg for a single.
Darts it on off, played to the leg side.
Full on off, defended watchfully.
Full ball on off, worked to the off side.
Loopy ball on off, Masvaure plays it with soft hands to ocvers.
Serves it on off, defended well in front of the crease.
Leg bye! Fuller on the pads, Ervine looks to flick but it goes off the pads to the leg side. They cross for a leg bye.
Loopy ball on off, Ervine comes to the pitch of the ball and plays it to covers.
Serves it on off, worked to the off side.
Tossed up ball on off, blocked watchfully.
PRINCE MASVAURE is the next batsman in.

OUT! Santner gets the wicket of the nightwatchman! Darts it on middle and leg, Donald off his back foot tries to block it but is beaten by the pace there. The appeal for lbw is on straightaway and after a long pause, the umpire raises his dreaded finger. Tiripano is not happy and rightly so as the replays show that the ball was going down leg.
Tossed up on off, defended off his front foot.
Short and wide outside off, Donald goes back in his crease and tries to cut but miscues it.
Darts it up on off, pushes to the off side.
Quicker through the air and into the pads, a play and a miss and the ball hits the pads. That was a good ball and deserved a wicket for sure. Nevertheless, unfortunate for the bowler.
Fuller ball on off, Ervine stays tall and plays it with soft hands to the off side.
Loopy ball from wide outside off, driven at ease against the turn to covers.
Bowls it on the pads, Ervine punches it to mid-wicket.
Serves it full this time, Craig strides forward and defends it.
Leg-spinning ball from outside off, pushed to cover.
Ish Sodhi to bowl for the first time in the 2nd innings.
Short and wide outside off, left alone.
Tossed up ball on off, the ball goes off the outside edge to the off side.
Serves it on off, defended watchfully.
Short ball outside off, cut to point.
Serves it on off, pushed to covers for a single.
That was close! Tossed up ball on middle and leg, Ervine leans ahead and looks to defend. The ball lobs off his pads back to the keeper. A half-hearted appeal for caught behind is turned down.
Length ball on middle and off, played back to the bowler.
Full on off, pushed to mid off.

FOUR! Short and punished! Hurls a short ball on middle and leg, Donald rides the bounce by pulling it to square leg. Boult puts in a dive to save, he does a good job but the ball ricochets to the ropes off his body. A boundary is signaled by the umpire.
Short and outside off, Donald off his back foot punches it to short cover.
On the pads, tucked to mid-wicket for a single.
A good length ball on middle and off, Ervine strides forward and defends it to covers.
Short and wide outside off, Donald works it to the off side.
Serves it full on off, pushed to covers.
Tad short and Donald off his back foot cuts it to point.
That spun a mile! Tossed up ball on off, it spins away after pitching. Donald goes for a cut but is beaten.
Darts it up on off, another forward defence by Tiripano.
Tossed up ball outside off, Donald leans ahead and blocks it out. A bit of an inside edge there.
FOUR! Delicate! Fuller ball outside off, Craig drives it past backward point for a boundary. End of an exciting over there.
Another angled delivery, it stayed low but Ervine did well to block it in the end.
Back of a length ball on the sixth stump line, Ervine off his back foot punches it to covers for no runs.
Full and wide outside off, Ervine looks to play at it but is beaten.
Angles in a full ball, Craig is not bothered and lets it through.
Southee from around the wicket bowls it on off, Ervine lets it through.
Tim Southee this time has a short cover and a short point in place...
Short and wide outside off, Donald tries to cut it away but gets it off the toe end of the bat to first slip.
Serves it on off, pushed to the off side.
Tosses it up on middle and off, Donald at ease defends it to covers.
Darts it in on off, a solid block by the nightwatchman.
Loopy on middle and leg, Ervine leans into it and sweeps it to square leg for a single.
Short and wide outside off, spinning away from the batsman. Donald stays tall and punches it through covers. Latham chases it and stops them to three runs.
Mitchell Santner to bowl now.
Fuller ball on middle and leg, Donald pushes it to mid on for a single.
Short and wide outside off, Donald sees it thud into the gloves of the keeper.
Serves it on off stump, Tiripano presses forward and blocks it to the off side.
FOUR! What a shot! Full ball on off, similar length once again from Southee. Donald drives it at ease through covers for a boundary.
A good length ball on middle and off, the nightwatchman strides forward and defends it in front of the track.
Southee starts with a full ball on off, Tiripano off his front foot looks to block it but misses.
Interesting field set up here. Southee has a silly point, a slip, gully, backward point and a short cover in place. All brought in really close.
Drinks break!
On a length and outside off, Tiripano plays this to point and takes a quick single.
Full on the stumps, bunted down towards mid off. No run taken.
Has a change of angles and comes over the wicket, fires in a yorker perfectly on middle and off, Tiripano is up for it though and does well to dig out. Well bowled and well played.
A short one on middle and leg, angling in, Donald ducks and avoids it.
Angles in a full ball around off, blocked out well off the front foot in front of the cover region.
Wagner continues from around the wicket, pitches it up to Tiripano, but it's well outside off and the nightwatchman has no problem lunging forward and letting it be.
Full from Southee, aims it at the base of the off stump, Craig lungs forward and drives it to covers. Maiden over from Tim.
Solid shot but it's straight to the fielder. Ervine drives this full ball to covers. Gets nothing for it. Unfortunate.
Tad short and shaping in quite a lot, Ervine is still confident enough to not play at it.
Wide outside off, left alone.
Back of a length and outside off, it's quite straight, left alone by the southpaw.
Starts from around the wicket, bowls it full and well outside off, driven to covers. No run taken.
TIM SOUTHEE is back into the attack.
Sharply coming in on a fuller length into Tiripano, was late in bringing his bat down but just about manages to keep it out.
Length ball aimed at the top of off stump, blocked out well by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
That was sharp. Wagner angles in a length ball outside off, comes in heavily as Donald raises his hands to leave it. Whiskers just past the off pole, too. Close call.
Fuller length ball angling in, buried into the track ahead with the full face of the bat.
Good discipline from Tiripano, keeps his patience as well. It's on a length and outside off, no shot offered to that one.
Starts off from around the wicket, Tiripano shoulders his arms to this one.
Fuller in length once more, a solid front foot defense presented by the batsman.
Full on middle and off, defended out right in front of him.

RIPPER FROM BOULT! Fires it on a fullish length and in the corridor outside off, it's shapes in sharply after pitching, Ervine leans forward and raises his bat to leave it. The ball just, barely goes past the off pole as Watling collects it in his safe gloves.
Extremely full and outside off, Ervine opens the face a bit and drives it through covers. Good diving stop by the fielder there to stop the ball from going past him.
Too full and just outside off, bunted back down the ground. No run taken.
Fires in a full ball on the stumps, Craig with a drive to mid off.
From around the wicket, it's a length ball well outside off, quite harmless as it's left alone. That'll be the end of the over.
Full and aimed at the stumps, driven to mid on.
On a good length outside off, it's played to point for nothing.
Fuller delivery pitched across the right-hander, no shot offered to this one as well.
Pitched up there and getting it to angle away from the nightwatchman, he does well to leave it alone.
Too straight from Neil, it's on the pads and it's easily tucked behind square on the leg side for a single.

STIFLED LBW APPEAL! Boult fires this in full and just outside off, it's swinging in and looking dangerous, Tiripano lunges forward for the drive but gets a big inside edge onto his pads. The umpire is correct in turning down the lbw appeal.
Fuller in length and slightly shapes away from the southpaw outside off, Craig opens the face of the bat and dabs it to point for a single.
Another one full and just outside off, once again it's driven to mid off. Dot ball.
Fired in on off, driven down to mid off. It's straight to the fielder so no run is taken.
Touch fuller and in the channel outside off, Ervine leans forward and blocks it out well off the front foot.
Touch short of a length and seaming away outside off, Ervine makes a good leave to that.
Fullish on the stumps, Donald Tiripano plants his foot forward and hits it back to the bowler.
Fires in full on leg, Donald does well to get his bat down in time and gently tap it to the leg side.
Wagner pitches this up, well outside off, DT has nothing to do with it.
On a good length and once again it's outside off, Tiripano strides forward only to let it go.
Angles this away from the batsman and outside off, Tiripano raises his bat skywards and lets the ball go past him.
Wagner comes charging in, immediately hits the deck hard, wasting no time. It's pitched fuller in length as Tiripano comes forward to block.
NEIL WAGNER comes into the attack.
FOUR! EDGED AND AWAY! Length ball outside of, Ervine prods forward and goes for the booming drive. Gets an edge which falls a little short of second slip and races away to the fence behind.
Fuller delivery pitched outside off, moving away from the left-hander, left alone.
FOUR! He's finally off the mark! Too full on middle and leg, too straight from Boult, Ervine leans across and flicks it through the gap in the mid-wicket region for a boundary.
Length ball tailing away late from Craig Ervine, outside off, he goes for the drive and gets an edge. However it goes along the ground to the slip cordon.
Nice length ball outside off, arms are shouldered to this one.
Angling in around off, Ervine presses ahead and blocks it out with a straight bat.
Length delivery well outside off, not bothered with. Stylishly left alone, too.
Fuller in length, outside off, it's driven to covers.
Edged.. but it falls short! Length ball outside off, coming in a touch and Tiripano loosely hangs his bat out to this. Gets an edge but it falls short of first slip as he played it with soft hands.
Banged in short once more from Southee, ducked and evaded.
Faster one from Southee, bangs it in short around off, 135 kph, Donald rises quickly and taps it down on the off side. Nicely done.
Coming in around off, Donald Tiripano stays in his crease and blocks it out well.
Fullish on the stumps, driven down to mid on. No run taken.
Full and outside off, some late away movement which does Ervine in. He looks to drive this away but is beaten at all ends. Terrific delivery.
Back of a length outside off, a shade of movement for Trent, Craig isn't interested in playing at those.
Boult comes from around the wicket, fires it and aims the base of off stump, Tiripano opens the face slightly and bunts it towards point. Picks up a single for it.

FOUR! Shot. Lovely timing on that. Full and fired in outside off, Tiripano beautifully drives this through cover-point. This time he gets all of it and leaves no chance for any fielder to stop it. Picks up a boundary.
Fullish on the stumps, Donald defends this into the track with a strong bat.
Comes around the wicket for the last ball of the over, pitches it on a good length and outside off, Ervine looks to drive this away but misses.

Extremely full outside off, a half-volley really from Southee, Tiripano leans into the shot and drives it a little square through cover-point. Latham chases after the ball and puts in a valiant dive. Just about manages to parry it back just inside the ropes. Great effort from the Kiwi opener, saves a vital run for his side. Restricts the batsmen to three.
Better line from Southee, pitches this closer to off and on a good length, nipping in a touch, it's well dealt with as it's solidly blocked to covers.
Good length ball outside the off stump, left alone for the keeper to collect.
Fires it full in length and outside off, Donald has nothing to do with that one.
In the channel outside off, pitched on a length as well, Tiripano opens the face of the bat and dabs it to point.
Length ball on middle and leg, much straighter from the left-arm pacer, Ervine leans across and flicks it to the mid-wicket fielder. Dot ball.
Once again it's fuller outside off and moving away, Craig is unmoved. Doesn't bother himself with that as Watling shuffles across to his left to collect it.
Pitched up fractionally fuller and shaping away from Craig Ervine outside off, he makes a watchful leave to this one.
Good length delivery outside off, it's not as close to the stumps as it probably should be, easy leave for Ervine.

Bowls this on the hips, Tiripano pushes this to square leg. He's caught ball watching and then realizes that his partner is already halfway down the pitch. He sets off and then scurries to the other end to complete a single.
Trent starts off with a sharp bumper, Tiripano is alert to this and quickly ducks to let the ball go over his body.
Slightly fuller outside off, pushed down to mid off to end the over.
Tim Southee has a change of angles, comes around the wicket to Ervine, bowls a fuller length delivery which straightens up a bit on middle and off, defended well into the track ahead.
Full and aimed at the base of off stump, Craig drives it down to mid off for no run.
Well outside off, harmless delivery as it's left alone by the batsman.
Fullish delivery which is shaping in to the batsman, a strong defensive shot presented by the left-hander.
Tim bowls this fuller in length and just outside off, kept out comfortably by Craig Ervine. No trouble there.
Full and swinging in just outside off, Tiripano leans into the block and keeps it out solidly. End of the over.

HUGE LBW SHOUT! But it's turned down by the umpire. Fuller in length and Boult gets this to come in to the batsman, he tries to flick it away but misses and is rapped on the pads. Loud shouts all around for an leg before but it's correctly refused. The ball pitched outside the line of leg stump.
Just back of a length, Boult hitting the deck hard, Donald doesn't bother himself with it.
Length ball angled across Tiripano, he's disciplined enough not to poke at it.
Tad fuller in length and outside off, shaping away from the batsman, it's easily left alone.

Starts off brilliantly. Getting some movement here Boult. It's on a good length and just outside off, it comes in after pitching, Tiripano stays back and raises his arms to leave the ball alone. Just misses the off pole. Close one. Got to be careful leaving the ball when Boult is bowling that line.
TRENT BOULT to bowl from the other end.
On a good length and moving away from Craig outside off, he withdraws his bat and lets it go past him into the keeper's gloves. Good delivery to end the over.
Tim pitches this one up, and it's outside off, clearly inviting Ervine to drive. He doesn't though and lets it be.
A similar ball, bowled well outside off, left alone by the southpaw.
Southee with a length delivery angled across, touch fuller and it's pitched outside off, Ervine leans forward and shoulders his arms to it.

The fielders and the umpires are out there in the middle. Donald Tiripano, the nightwatchman and Craig Ervine are at the crease. Craig Ervine will take the strike. Tim Southee will finish his pending over. Here we go...

The home side were determined in the last session on day 4, as they saw off 16 overs until those fall of wickets towards the day's end. They will look to draw the match from now on. Do join us in a while for the cricketing action.

Hello and warm greetings to everyone on the final day of the 2nd  Test between Zimbabwe and New Zealand. The match is nicely set for all 3 outcomes. The hosts have 7 wickets in hand and a target to achieve. On the other hand, New Zealand have 90 overs to bowl out Zimbabwe and win the Test series 2-0.
... Day 5, Session 1 ...

Earlier in the day, New Zealand batted in the second session and strengthened their lead with Kane Williamson and Ross Taylor scoring their fifties. Williamson became the 2nd Test batsman to score a century and a fifty against Zimbabwe in a single match, yet another feat for him. Will it be a 2-0 win for the Kiwis? Or will the hosts provide some resistance on day 5? Do join us for a cracking day of cricket tomorrow at 09:30 local time. Until then, take care and goodbye.

The Rhodesians need 329 more runs and have 7 wickets in hand. On the other hand, the visiting side will be delighted to notch those 3 wickets. All the pace bowlers picked a wicket each and have set the tone for tomorrow.

Zimbabwe tried to negotiate the final session just like day 2 but this time the opening stand choked. They played well until they lost Chamu Chibhabha at the score of 45 and then Tino Mawoyo and Sikandar Raza saw the team reeling at 58/3. Chasing a target of 387, the home side went after it cautiously but towards the end of the day they tumbled like nine pins.

OUT! Got him... yes gone! Southee thought it's dead plumb but replays show it might be going down leg as well. Be it anything, NZ are all smiles. Southee angles in a length delivery outside off, Raza looks to defend but is beaten by the inward movement and gets struck on the pads. Southee didn't even bother looking back at the umpire and starts to celebrate. Looked sliding down the leg side but umpire Paul Reiffel thinks the other way. Sikandar Raza Butt has to walk back and THAT IS ALSO STUMPS ON THE PENULTIMATE DAY!
Full and down the leg side, Raza looks to flick it across the line but misses.
DONALD TIRIPANO, the nightwatchman walks in next!

OUT! A loud shout for lbw and it's given! Trent Boult in his typical fashion of getting down on one knee and begging for an appeal, so adorable he looks! Anyway coming to the ball, he pitches it up on middle, gets it to curl in after pitching, Mawoyo prods forward to defend but the ball skids a bit, beats his defense and goes on to hit him on the back pad. Boult turns back to appeal and the umpire raises his finger.
In the channel on off, Mawoyo lifts his bat and lets it go through the keeper.
Fuller on off, pushed towards covers.
Tino chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.

FOUR! Blazing shot that! Fuller length delivery served in the channel on off, Mawoyo leans into it and drives it gloriously through covers. The fielder there dives to stop that one but misses as the ball goes towards the fence.
Fuller length ball on off, Mawoyo shoulders his arms to that one.
Fuller length delivery outside off, SR comes ahead and leaves it alone.
Strays it down the leg side, Sikandar Raza Butt ducks to evade it.
Fuller length delivery on middle, Raza defends it back to Southee.
Back of a length ball outside off, Raza leaves it for the keeper.
Serves it full and wide outside off, Sikandar sees it thud into the gloves of the keeper.
Back of a length ball on middle and leg, Raza stays tall and pushes it to the on side.
Hurls a length ball outside off, left alone.
Back of a length ball outside off, cut to the off side for a brace.
On outside off, pushed to mid off.
Another full ball on off, Mawoyo strides ahead and pushes it to covers.
Tad full on off, driven to covers.
Bye! Length ball wide outside off, left alone by Tino. It beats the keeper too and the batsmen cross for a run. Bye signaled by the umpire.
Outside off, left alone.
Short and outside off, Tino leaves it alone.
Fuller on middle, defended off the front foot gently.

A loud shout for caught behind! On a length and around off, nipping in back sharply. Mawoyo looks to poke at it but the ball goes under his bat and Watling behind the stumps takes it. They all go up in an appeal but the umpire stays unmoved.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Angles a length delivery on middle, Mawoyo defends it off the front foot.
Short and down the leg side, the batsman ducks to evade it.
Fuller length delivery on off, driven straight to the man at covers.
Fuller on the leg stump, flicked past short leg for a single.
Gets behind the line and defends it down.
Bouncer! The batsman ducks under the bouncer at the last moment.
On a length and around off, Raza gets forward and defends it down.
Fullish in the channel on off, Mawoyo defends it down.
Short of a length ball on middle, Tino ducks in sanity.
Good length delivery outside off, punched towards the off side.
Angles a length delivery on the pads, the batsman looks to flick but misses as the ball goes off his pads towards the leg side.
Landed outside off, punched towards covers.
On a length and outside off, Mawoyo comes forward and defends it down.
TIM SOUTHEE into the attack now!
Back of a length ball on off, lofted to mid off. The batsmen cross for a single. Santner dives to his right and stops the ball to fire it at the non-striker's end. No harm done and single is taken.
Short ball on off, cut to point.
Length ball too wide outside off, left alone.
A good length ball on off, moving away from the batsman. The batsman lets it through.
Tad short on off, steered to point for a brace.
Length ball on off, Tino strides forward and blocks it in front of the track.
Floated ball around off, Raza pushes it towards covers.
Flatter one on middle, tucked towards square leg for a single.
An arm ball around off, blocked out well.
Comes forward and defends it down.
Loops it up around off, Mawoyo gets forward and steers it past first slip for a double.
Loopy ball around off, defended watchfully.
Fuller on off, defended off the front foot. That ends a superb over.
SIKANDAR RAZA is the new man in!

OUT! Edged and gone! Double C you gotta go! Wagner draws first blood here! He angles it away from the batsman from over the wicket, Chibhabha gets a bit squared up as he gets an outside edge which flies in the safe hands of Guptill at second slip. New Zealand are delighted as they have gotten a breakthrough. Chamu walks back after doing the hard work.
The batsman has attempted to put bat on ball - but fails.
CC was beaten and missed the line of the delivery.
On a length and outside off, defended off the back foot.
Fuller length delivery outside off, driven through covers. Santner gives it a chase and does well to scoop the ball back. Three runs picked up.
On middle and leg, nudged towards mid-wicket for a single.
Loopy ball around off, driven back to the bowler.
Gets forward to defend but the ball turns away and he gets beaten up.
Outside off, punched off the back foot towards covers.
Tino has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Loopy ball around off, Mawoyo looks to cut but misses.
Banged short on middle, Chibhabha stands tall and taps it down.
Tad short on middle, pulled toward square leg for no runs.
Angles a short ball on middle, Mawoyo tucks it towards fine leg for a single.
FOUR! Pulled away! Short of a length delivery on middle, Mawoyo gets back, rides the bounce and pulls it over the man at square leg for a boundary.
On a length and outside off, defended off the back foot.
Good length delivery on middle and off, defended off the back foot.
Loopy ball around off, punched towards cover.
CC has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Flatter one on middle, Chibhabha shows a straight bat.
Full and around middle, defended off the front foot.
Short and outside off, the batsman cuts it off the back foot towards backward point for a couple.
Loopy ball around middle, flicked towards mid-wicket.
Drinks are on the field...
Full ball on the pads, Tino tries to flick it away but is beaten. The fielding side is asking questions for a catch behind the stumps. The umpire turns it down. Maybe it was going off the thigh pads.
FOUR! Deliberate! Short ball outside off, Tino stays tall and upper cuts it over slip cordon for a boundary.
Full ball on off, played to the leg side.
Similar length but line was on middle and leg, Mawoyo stays tall and fends it to the leg side.
FOUR! Up and over! Back of a length ball outside off, Tino stays tall and lofts it through mid off for a boundary.
Short ball on middle and leg, played to the leg side for a single.
Flighted ball on the stumps, blocked neatly.
Tossed up on middle and leg, defended off his front foot.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
A play and a miss! Tosses up outside off, it spins away after pitching. Tino tries to cut that away but is beaten.
Serves it short outside off, Tino gets back and cuts it to covers.
Tossed up ball on off, defended neatly.
Similar ball and Chamu lets it through once again. End of over there.
Short ball from over the wicket. it goes down the leg side. Chamu leaves it as it was a nothing delivery.
Fuller ball on the pads, worked to the leg side for a single.
Another short ball outside off, Tino looks at it and leaves it for the keeper.
Short ball on off, Mawoyo ducks in to let it through.
Short ball down the leg side. Tino lets it through. The fielders are all around the bat.
Tosses up nicely on off, Chibhabha drives it to covers.
On the pads, whipped off to square leg.
Floats it up on off, defended to the leg side.
Loopy ball on off, it spins away from the batsman while he looks to block it.
Loopy ball outside off, cut to point.
Tossed up ball on off, Chamu defends it to the off side.
MITCHELL SANTNER into the attack now!
Angles in a short ball. It is directed into the rib-cage. Tino tries to keep it down but it goes to square leg. Lucky to survive.
Hurls a short ball over the batsman's head. Left alone.
Dropped!  Short ball from around the wicket, the bounce gets high. Tino fends it and the ball goes into the hands of FSL fielder. Tough luck for the fielding side as he drops that.
Length ball outside off, Tino tries to play at it and is beaten.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Bowls a full ball on off, Tino defends it solidly.
FOUR! Cheeky! Fuller ball on off, Chamu awaits for it and steers it fine through short third man for a boundary.
Hurls it from over the wicket now. The line is way down the leg side. Chamu leaves it alone.
Bowls a superb bouncer on middle and leg, Chamu ducks in to let that ball go pass over him.
Tad full, width on offer too. Chamu strides forward and drives it to covers.
Angles in  a length ball from wide outside the crease. Chibhabha tucks it to square leg for no runs.
Boult comes steaming in from around the wicket. Chamu stays tall and bunts it back to the bowler.
Bouncer! Short ball on middle and leg, Tino lets it through.
Short ball on middle and leg, negotiated to the leg side off his back foot.
Full ball on off, it gets high after the pitch of the ball. Tino fends it to the off side.
Length ball outside off, angling away from the batsman. Mawoyo tries to play at it and is beaten.
Bowls a tad short on off, Mawoyo stays back and defends it to the off side.
Full ball on off, angling in. Tino presses forward and pushes it to covers.
Neil Wagner to bowl now.
Hurls in a length ball on off, Chamu blocks it.
On middle and leg, played to the leg side.
Short ball on middle and leg, Tino tries to play it to the leg side but it goes of the glove to the on side for a single.
Hurls in a length ball on off, Tino defends it to the off side.
Fuller ball on off, pushed to mid off.
Length ball outside off, Mawoyo looks to play but is beaten.
FOUR! Top shot! On a length and around off, Chibhabha punches it past the bowler down the ground. That shot had timing written all over it. Brilliant batting!
CC does well to stand tall and play that short delivery.
FOUR! Pulled away! Short of a length delivery on middle, Chibhabha gets on the top of the bounce and pulls it through square leg for a boundary.
Fuller length delivery on off, Chibhabha drives it straight to short cover.
Good length delivery on middle, Chibhabha defends it with a straight bat.
Short of a length delivery on middle, Chibhabha pulls it in front of square for a couple.
Comes from round the wicket and bowls a back of a length, tucks it towards mid-wicket.
Fuller on middle, flicked towards mid-wicket.
Yorker on middle, Mawoyo digs it out.
Banged it short on middle, Mawoyo ducks to evade it.
Fuller length delivery on middle, driven towards mid on.
Outside off, left alone.
The batsman does well to stand tall and play that short delivery.

FOUR! Glorious! Fuller length delivery in the channel on off, double C lunges forward and drills it through covers for a boundary. That will hurt any bowler, a drop on the previous ball and then a boundary on next. Can feel the pain, Southee.

In the air... dropped! Angles a full length delivery on middle, Chibhabha looks to flick it across the line but gets a leading edge towards second slip. Guptill dives to his right but spills it out at the last moment. Tino gets a life and Tim is really unhappy there.
Fuller length delivery on middle, CC defends it off the front foot.
Tad full and around off, driven towards the man at covers.
Short of a length delivery on middle, Chibhabha hops in the crease and fends it away on the off side.
Outside off, TM lifts his bat and lets it go through to the keeper.
On a length and outside off, nipping in sharply. Mawoyo looks to defend but gets an inside edge on the pads.
Gets behind the line and defends it down.
In the channel outside off, Mawoyo shoulders his arms.
Leg bye! Full and strayed on the pads, Chibhabha looks to flick but misses and the ball goes off his pads towards the leg side. A leg bye is taken.
On a length around off, defended gently.
TRENT BOULT to share the new cherry from the other end!
Good length ball on off, steered towards point. Just a boundary from the first over then!
That was a close shave! Fuller length delivery on off, shaping in a bit. Mawoyo presses forward and shoulders his arms to that one.
Banged short on middle, Mawoyo ducks under it in sanity.
Fuller length delivery outside off, TM gets forward and defends it down towards the off side.
On a length and outside off, Tino defends it off the back foot.
FOUR! A my goodness! What a shot first up! Southee bowls a fuller length delivery on off, Mawoyo gets forward and drives it beautifully through mid off for a blazing boundary. Top shot first up!
